basic_info.description: Top floor condo in historic North Beach! This property has so much potential. Enjoy city life at your fingertips, featuring breathtaking views of San Francisco Bay, Alcatraz and Coit Tower. Just steps to neighborhood cafes, restaurants, shopping, night clubs and more. Open floorplan with fireplace and in-unit laundry. Common roof deck and incredible 360 degree views + bbq area. Secured elevator building with 1 garage parking space, street parking permit and storage area. Washington Square Park is nearby. Easy public transportation access is incredible.
